title: Figure 6: Denver five-year cumulative savings, RavenWindow vs. incumbent window filters
description: Line chart titled "Denver Five-Year Cumulative Savings (holding energy prices constant)" plotting dollar savings ($0 to $3,000) against "Months Installed" (0 to 60). Seven series are compared: RavenWindow + Low-E (highest, near $2,900), Pilkington K-Glass, Oldcastle Sunglass, Viracon VRE238, AFG Comfort TiR, 99% Transmissive Low-E and 99% Reflective Low-E. The caption reads "Figure 6. RavenWindow Smart Window Film Performance vs. Leading Incumbent Window Filters," followed by text introducing thermal management of spacecraft.
